load_npy_from_bytes: load a NumPy NDArray from bytes data generated by numpy.save without copying
load_npy_with_copy: load a NumPy NDArray from bytes data with an explicit copy of the buffer
load_npz_archive: load a numpy NPZ archive file from bytes and return an NpzFile mapping object
access_npz_array_by_key: access an array from an NpzFile object by key with or without the .npy suffix
iterate_npz_files: iterate over the list of file names in an NpzFile object using its Mapping interface
